description: Reviewed canonical bindings for source-occurrence navigation. approval and relationship are separate. Only approval=APPROVED enables Saḿskrta Shloka navigation. shloka-source-index is not authoritative.

bindings.reviewNote: Same Shvetashvatara/Katha eko'varno verse (full unit). SS16 omits initial य, uses tighter sandhi (e.g. बहुधाशक्ति, वर्णानेकान्निहितार्थोदधाति), विचैति vs वि चैति, and देव स: vs स देवः. Lexical content unchanged; orthographic/transmission variant only.

Same Katha Upanishad anor-aniyan verse (full unit). Differences are sandhi/spacing, avagraha vs sandhi (आत्माऽस्य/आत्मास्य), visarga presentation (तमक्रतु:/तमक्रतुः), and वीतशोको vs बीतशोको orthography. No change of verse identity.

SS16 cites only the second pada of canonical two-line ch-verses-p131. Navigation to full canonical record allowed; full canonical Roman must not display under this partial occurrence unless fragment-aligned.

Same friendship-qualities verse (full unit). Differences include compound spacing, visarga/colon presentation, anusvara (भवेन्मित्रम्/भवेन्मित्रं), and sandhi — textual/orthographic variant, not format-only.

Same Svetasvatara eko devah two-line verse (full unit). Differences are visarga/colon presentation (देव:/देवः, गूढ़:/गूढः, कर्माध्यक्ष:/कर्माध्यक्षः), nukta in गूढ़, and punctuation — orthographic/transmission variant only; verse identity unchanged.

Same Gita 18.66 sarva-dharma verse (full unit). Key lexical difference: SS16 मोक्षयिस्यामि vs canonical मोक्षयिष्यामि (future -iṣyāmi spelling); plus visarga/colon and comma spacing. Same verse identity — VARIANT, not strict EXACT.

SS16 cites only the second line/pada of canonical two-line ch-verses-p318. Includes नियछेद् vs canonical नियच्छेद् orthography within the cited portion. Navigation to full p318; fragment-aligned Roman only.

Full यच्छेद् वाङ्मनसि प्राज्ञ… ज्ञानमात्मनि महति… two-line verse (complete unit). Same canonical identity as ch-verses-p320. Differences are sandhi/orthography/presentation (e.g. वाङ्गमनसि vs वाङ्मनसी, नियछेद् vs नियच्छेत्, spacing). ch-verses-p318 and ch-verses-p513 are partial/overlapping evidence only — p320 is the authoritative full-record target. SS16 Devanagari unchanged.
Human-approved textual corrections (प्राणाः, यथात्मनोऽभीष्टः, भूतानाम्) brought occurrence to strictExact. Full two-line verse; canonical Roman enrichment permitted.

Same sukhaṃ vāñchati / dharmasya verse (full unit). Human-approved वाञ्छति + समुद्भूतः applied. Remaining diffs: सर्वोहि/सर्वो हि, तस्मात् धर्म:/तस्माद्धर्म, sandhi/colon presentation. SS16 Devanagari preserved; canonical Roman may mismatch displayed reading.

Same dyotate krīḍate / devaḥ verse (full unit). Human-approved क्रीडते applied. Remaining diffs: तस्मत्/तस्माद्, visarga/colon, सर्व देवतैः/सर्वदेवतैः. SS16 Devanagari preserved; canonical Roman may mismatch displayed reading.
SS16 cites only the embedded line आत्माऽस्य जन्तोर्निहितो गुहायाम् from Katha Upanishad ch-verses-p6 (cf. ch4-p2 full-unit VARIANT binding). Avagraha vs sandhi presentation; partial occurrence only.

SS16 cites only the second half (धर्मस्य तत्त्वं… महाजनो…) of full four-line canonical ch-verses-p394 (श्रुतयो विभिन्नाः… + धर्मस्य…). Verified p394 is the complete canonical record; partial records p201/p579 are supporting duplicates only.

Same Mundaka ksaram/pradhana two-line verse (full unit). Differences: spacing/anusvara (प्रधानं/प्रधानम, हर:/हरः), क्षरात्मानं/क्षरात्मनाव, visarga/colon, and compound split विश्वमाया निवृत्ति/विश्वमायानिवृत्तिः. Same complete shloka as p131; distinct from ch6-p10 which cites second pada only.

Same full four-line śrutayo vibhinnāḥ / dharmasya tattvam hymn (full unit). p394 is the complete canonical record. Differences are sandhi/spacing (श्रुतियोर्विभिन्ना/श्रुतयो विभिन्नाः), visarga/colon, and येनगता:/येन गतः — transmission variant only; cf. ch5-p9 which cites second half as FRAGMENT. Canonical Hindi meaning (BABA_EXPLICIT_TRANSLATION) approved for full-unit reuse.

Same Gita 13.30 kāla/svabhāva verse (full unit). Differences are line-break layout, visarga/colon (काल:/कालः), sandhi spacing (पुरुषेति/पुरुष इति, त्वात्म भावाद/त्वात्मभावाद्), and compound split सुख दु:ख हेतौ:/सुखदुह्खहेतोः — orthographic/layout variant; verse identity unchanged.

Same full Mundaka/Katha-style verse (4-line unit). Human-approved: वृहत्/बृहत्, compound splitting, तादिहान्तिके/तदिहान्तिके — textual/orthographic differences only; canonical identity clear. SS16 Devanagari unchanged. p270/p271 are partial/overlap evidence only.

Same Bhag-definition verse (2-line unit). SS16 omits canonical समग्रं; substantive differences include तू षण्णम् vs षणां. Canonical identity clear — VARIANT not EXACT. SS16 source Devanagari preserved unchanged.

Same full four-pada stotra confession hymn (100% structural coverage). Lexical differences include कल्पितं/वर्णितम् and especially यापित्वञ्च/व्यापित्वं च — VARIANT not EXACT. SS16 Devanagari unchanged; occurrence-specific Roman; canonical Hindi meaning not auto-reused without meaningApplicability approval.

p292 is preferred over p293 because it preserves भूत्वा and the पातकैः textual pattern closer to the SS16 occurrence. p293 remains alternate evidence only (बुद्धया vs भूत्वा is a substantive lexical fork). SS16 Devanagari unchanged; occurrence-specific Roman.

Full passage preserved in compressed/rearranged 2-line form with यथा…तथा… frame; not FRAGMENT. p327 is an alternate yathā/tathā witness, not the authoritative navigation target. p183 is cleaner complete canonical record. SS16 Devanagari unchanged; occurrence-specific Roman.

Hindi दशम खण्ड · शिवोपदेश opening verse is the same Na muktih shástravyákhyáne unit as EN Part 10 ch6-p1 / Namah Shiváya Shántáya ch17-p1.
